title: Intro: The Four Seasons
text: >> Spring, summer,  fall, and winter, too. >> Let's learn the seasons,  me and you.

title: Springtime & Growing Gardens
text: >> Springtime comes with flowers bright. >> Butterflies take happy flight. >> Raindrops help the gardens  grow. >> Little seeds begin to show. >> Summer brings the warm sunshine.

title: Summer Sunshine & Outdoor Fun
text: >> Play outside, it feels so fine. >> Swimming, laughing, having fun. >> Long bright days  for everyone.

title: Fall Colors & Crunching Leaves
text: Fall arrives with colors bold. >> Red and orange, yellow,  gold. >> Leaves go crunch beneath our feet. >> Cool fresh air is crisp and sweet.

title: Winter Snow & Building Snowmen
text: Winter  brings the chilly snow. Watch the frosty breezes blow. [singing] Bundle up and zip your coat. >> Build a snowman, scarf  and coat.

title: Outro: Every Season Brings Us Cheer!
text: >> Spring, summer, fall, and winter, [singing] too. Seasons change for me  and you. >> Round and round throughout the year.  >> Every season brings  us cheer.
